latestVersion.changelog:
AI Video Generator for YouTube — Version 1.0.0

- Initial release: Instantly turn scripts or text prompts into 1080p, YouTube-ready videos with AI.
- No manual editing: Simply upload your script or describe the video you want, and receive an MP4 within minutes.
- Seamless onboarding: Automatic session/token setup and free anonymous usage with credits.
- Supports uploads, timeline editing, exporting, and balance checks through simple commands.
- Multi-format support: Export videos in MP4, MOV, AVI, and more.
- Built-in cloud rendering: All processing happens on GPU nodes for fast, high-quality results.
